description: AICTIONBOT™ role profile by KULIC Advisory (tool 38), built on the Execution Toolkit templates T03 (process taxonomy with RASCI), T16 (competency assessment) and T18 (capability matrix). Takes the role name, level (operativ, strategisch, fuehrung, leitung), categories, approval limit in euros, who it reports to, and activities with a RACI letter each (R does, A is accountable, C is consulted, I is informed). Activities may be named in the user's own words or by number from the KULIC five-stage chain (1 strategy and categories, 2 sourcing and supplier selection, 3 contracts and supplier management, 4 ordering and goods receipt, 5 invoice, payment, master data; 30 activities, for example 2.5 negotiate, 4.3 approve purchase orders, 5.4 release payments). Returns purpose, RACI rows by stage, KPIs, skills, approval rule, segregation-of-duties conflicts (red, amber) and a job advertisement in German and English with a placeholder for what the employer offers. Deterministic, no AI, nothing stored. Needs sign-in: runs with an AICTIONBOT™ Werkbank licence; without a licence one check per connection every 30 days is free (sign in with “Connect without a licence”).

activities.description: Rows: activity (own words or chain number such as 2.5) and raci (R, A, C or I).

approval_limit.description: Approval limit per order in euros.

categories.description: Categories the role buys, e.g. packaging and logistics.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de. The job advertisement always comes in German and English.

level.description: Level: operativ (operational), strategisch (strategic), fuehrung (team lead), leitung (head of procurement).

role.description: Role name or job title, e.g. Strategic buyer packaging.
